name: Kouda Saya
source:
2nd year high school student.
Whenever she thinks a boy is nice she gets overly excited and her heart rate and blood pressure go up and she blushes like crazy.
She tries to hide this 'hot guy allergy' from everybody, only her childhood friend Riito knows.
